projectsSection.title: High-throughput systems, cloud infrastructure, and AI governance.
projectsSection.description: A curated selection of enterprise software architectures, DevSecOps pipelines, and intelligent agents built for the financial and technology sectors.
projectsSection.note: Projects subject to non-disclosure agreements (NDAs). Architectural diagrams and interfaces have been sanitized to protect proprietary client data.

projects.title: In-House Corporate Banking CRM
projects.description: Technical leadership and architectural design of the transactional corporate sales CRM for Banco de Bogotá.
projects.overlaySummary: High-availability commercial management platform for enterprise bankers and corporate relationship managers.
projects.challenge: Replace legacy fragmented tooling and spreadsheets with a unified, fault-tolerant platform capable of handling millions of real-time transactions under stringent financial compliance.
projects.roleHtml:
• Architected microservices and Clean Architecture with Angular, Node.js, and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Led an engineering squad of 8+ frontend and backend developers across agile sprints.
  • Engineered OAuth2/OIDC security protocols and encryption at rest and in transit.
  • Built automated DevSecOps pipelines with SonarQube, SAST, and Zero Downtime deployments.
projects.result: Unified enterprise commercial operations nationwide, boosting banker productivity by 38% and reducing corporate loan application cycle times by 60%.

projects.title: Autonomous Agent & Graph Ecosystem with LangChain
projects.description: Enterprise multi-agent architectures and deterministic graph workflows orchestrated using LangGraph and vector databases.
projects.overlaySummary: Production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system with semantic routing for commercial intelligence.
projects.challenge: Eliminate hallucinations and inject reliable transactional corporate context into LLMs for sensitive financial workflows.
projects.roleHtml:
• Engineered stateful multi-agent workflows with memory persistence and conditional routing via LangGraph and Python.
  • Implemented high-throughput embeddings ingestion into scalable vector databases.
  • Designed semantic guardrails to prevent prompt injections and corporate data leaks.
projects.result: Achieved a 92% reduction in hallucination rates and automated comprehensive commercial financial analysis in minutes instead of days.

projects.title: Multi-Cloud Infrastructure & DevSecOps Platform
projects.description: Elastic cloud topology, distributed observability, and automated CI/CD backed by Google Cloud ACE certification.
projects.overlaySummary: Continuous delivery platform leveraging containers, Kubernetes clusters, and Zero Trust security policies.
projects.challenge: Ensure 99.99% operational availability and strict banking audit compliance during month-end traffic spikes.
projects.roleHtml:
• Provisioned VPC network topologies, hybrid connectivity, and least-privilege IAM policies.
  • Established unified observability with p99 latency alerts and distributed tracing.
  • Designed infrastructure as code (IaC) and disaster recovery strategies using Terraform and Docker.
projects.result: Zero unscheduled downtime across critical banking periods and a 45% reduction in cloud infrastructure waste via intelligent auto-scaling.

projects.title: IoT Telemetry Core & Automation Engine
projects.description: Real-time edge signal acquisition, hardware telemetry, and cloud stream processing for robotics and industrial applications.
projects.overlaySummary: Connecting physical microcontrollers, sensors, and fieldbuses to cloud microservices.
projects.challenge: Capture and transmit physical sensor data with ultra-low latency across unstable edge connections.
projects.roleHtml:
• Applied Mechatronics Engineering principles to digital signal processing and embedded firmware.
  • Developed lightweight MQTT and WebSocket edge agents with local retry buffers.
  • Streamed real-time metrics to time-series cloud data stores.
projects.result: Enabled predictive maintenance for electromechanical equipment with zero telemetry packet loss.

quote: Good software architecture is not the most complex one; it is the one that solves the business challenge with the highest simplicity, security, and scalability.

about.title: Precision engineering meets strategic business vision.
paragraphs: I am a Mechatronics Engineer with a Postgraduate Specialization in Project Management (Universidad de Boyacá) and executive training in Management Competencies (Universidad de los Andes). I currently serve as Tech Lead and Software Architect at Banco de Bogotá, leading the technical design and delivery of the In-House Corporate Banking CRM.

I hold the official Google Cloud Certified Associate Cloud Engineer credential (Credly ID: 189954) alongside deep expertise in microservices design, DevSecOps pipelines, enterprise system integration, BigQuery, and state-of-the-art Generative AI with LangChain and LangGraph.
My approach merges the mathematical rigor of mechatronics with agile leadership and corporate outcome orientation: I engineer clean, scalable, secure architectures that drive tangible business value.
